chunks: Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

An elderly man and an elderly woman are to be flogged one hundred lashes and stoned. A virgin man and a virgin woman are to be flogged one hundred lashes and exiled for one year. Exile is from one city to another, and Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام did indeed exile two men from al-Kufah to al-Baṣrah.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَا: Commander of the Faithful, cited here as the one who implemented this ruling
key_terms.الرَّجْمَ: stoning as a prescribed legal punishment in this context
key_terms.الشَّيْخُ وَ الشَّيْخَةُ: the elderly man and elderly woman, mentioned here as a legal category
key_terms.النَّفْيُ مِنْ بَلَدٍ إِلَى بَلَدٍ: the definition of exile as removal from one town to another
key_terms.الْبِكْرُ وَ الْبِكْرَةُ: the virgin man and virgin woman, treated here as a distinct legal category

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about flogging, stoning, and exile in zina cases?
ai.summary: This hadith states legal punishments related to zina, distinguishing between the elderly man and woman and the virgin man and woman. It also defines exile as transfer from one town to another and cites a precedent from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام in applying that punishment.
